properties.label: Lévis / Lauzon
properties.note: Abraham born 1792 at Lauzon; married Rose Angèle Demers at Lévis, 29 Dec 1821. The family left Lower Canada in 1841.

properties.label: St. Paul
properties.note: 'They came via boat to St. Paul' (Neill).

properties.label: St. Boniface
properties.note: Red River, 1842–45. Rose Angélique married Alexander Ducharme here, 26 Nov 1844 (Wall).

properties.label: Little Canada
properties.note: Settled on section 8, beside Lake Gervais, 1845 (Neill).
